verdict.rationale: The developers page claims a first-party API you can 'use directly to take full control of your workflow', which suggests programmatic, non-UI operation, but there is no documentation of authentication, endpoints, or CI usage. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and markdown developer docs all returned 404. In-app automation rules are an adjacent feature, and the Zapier connection is an integration route rather than headless operation of the product itself. Missing for 10: published API reference/spec, documented token-based (non-interactive) auth suitable for CI, CLI or SDK, examples of headless/CI usage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
